New plan: 

In my previous attempt, I failed to consider the time intervals between the events when determining the possible times for each person to visit the respective locations. I should have taken into account the time gaps between the events, not just the time intervals of the events themselves. 

For example, in the case of Samantha, I should have noticed that there is a 2-hour gap between Samantha waking up at 5am and Lisa seeing Samantha driving to the water park from 8am to 12pm. This gap indicates that Samantha could have gone to the movies during this time. 

Next time, I will carefully examine the time intervals between the events and consider the time gaps between them when determining the possible times for each person to visit the respective locations.
